findings.summary: crates/athena-core/src/run_pin_tests.rs is not among the reading's deliverables
findings.evidence: A change outside the listed deliverables widens the scope.

findings.summary: The Run field lists only `cargo test`, but the criterion also requires `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check`.
findings.evidence: The demonstration's Run field says `cargo test`, while its Observes text describes all three commands exiting 0. Fix: List all three commands in the Run field, or say they run in sequence and each must exit 0.

findings.summary: The repeatable counting procedure mixes two signals: invocation records whose detail contains 'self-check failed', and a producer invocation count above one. It does not say which signal defines a send-back.
findings.evidence: In run_pin_tests.rs:759-761, both producer attempts contain 'self-check failed', including the last one, which is not followed by a send-back. Counting 'self-check failed' records therefore overcounts send-backs. Fix: Define a send-back as a job having two or more producer invocation records under records/<job>/invocations/. Say the rate is (jobs with a send-back) / (jobs read), with the sample size.

findings.summary: The complete-report full-run test may duplicate existing coverage. The default fake producer turn already reports every criterion as met, so existing happy-path tests probably already see one producer invocation.
findings.evidence: run_pin_tests.rs:190 builds a default criteria_check for the fake turn. Many existing full-run tests finish without a send-back. Fix: Keep (c), but make sure it asserts exactly one producer invocation record. Alternatively, point to an existing test that already asserts this, and avoid writing a redundant one.

findings.summary: The way test (b) will capture the second brief is left open.
findings.evidence: The Tweak type at run_pin_tests.rs:147 receives &AgentInvocation, which likely carries the brief, but the plan has not confirmed this. Fix: Have test (b) record the brief from the AgentInvocation passed to the Tweak on the second producer call, and assert that it contains '## Sent back' and the omitted criterion's text.

summary: I checked the plan's code references in the snapshot and they hold. unmet_criteria is at run.rs:1169 and criterion_key at run.rs:1186. The send-back text is inline at run.rs:1442-1454 and still says "(without its number or kind tag)". lib.rs:84 declares `mod run_pin_tests`. run_pin_tests.rs:722-768 has the full-run harness: athena_with plus a Tweak that counts producer invocation records. briefs.rs:224-225 tells the producer that records/ is absent, which supports reporting the before rates as unmeasured rather than invented. Each criterion has a matching demonstration, and each demonstration states how it would fail without the change. Criterion 5 is covered by three tests: a unit test of the extracted send_back_text, a full-run test with two invocations whose second brief names the omitted text, and a full-run test with one invocation. Putting the full-run tests in run_pin_tests.rs is justified because that is the only place the harness exists. Athena's own minor finding about that file is mitigated by the plan's note to the verifier. Only minor gaps remain.
